item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro is slightly leading President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in a simulated scenario of the October 25 presidential runoff, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday. The senator, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, would receive 49% of the vote compared with 45% for Lula, Datafolha poll showed. It is the first Datafolha poll after the [USN:L6N45N1A0 TEXT:"first-round vote"] on Sunday, in which the younger Bolsonaro surprisingly led Lula. The poll's result still represents a technical tie as the poll's margin of error is of plus-minus 2 percentage points. 5% of the respondents said they would cast a blank vote, and undecided voters made up 1%, the poll showed. Datafolha surveyed 2,520 people in-person between October 6-7.

item.title: US to livestream Army execution of Fort Hood shooter, Pentagon official says
item.description: The US will livestream the Army's upcoming firing squad execution on December 3 of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas, in a 2009 shooting spree, a Pentagon official said, in what would be an unprecedented move.
item.dc:creator: Phil Stewart
item.content:encoded: The US will livestream the Army's upcoming firing squad execution on December 3 of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood, Texas, in a 2009 shooting spree, a Pentagon official said, in what would be an unprecedented move. Hasan, a former Army psychiatrist, is set to become the first person to be executed by firing squad by the US military since 1945. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, who championed the push to execute Hasan by firing squad, had told the Human Events Daily program broadcast earlier on Thursday by Real America's Voice that he planned to make Hasan's execution public. Hegseth did not say how. "The Secretary is correct. It will be livestreamed. Details will follow," the Pentagon official told Reuters, speaking on condition of anonymity. Hegseth said deciding to execute Hasan by firing squad at Fort Hood on a Thursday at 1 pm — the approximate time, day of the week and location of the 2009 shooting — was a "no brainer." "We'll make sure that people are able to watch it, that it's public. Because people need to understand that ... there's serious consequences for these types of things," Hegseth said. Asked if Hasan had made any final requests, Hegseth said: "Don't care. We'll see him on December 3." PRESIDENT MUST APPROVE FIRING SQUAD EXECUTION A military jury sentenced Hasan to death in August 2013, after finding him guilty of 45 counts of premeditated murder and attempted premeditated murder for opening fire with a laser-sighted handgun in a medical facility at the sprawling central Texas military base. The shooting came weeks before Hasan, now 56, was scheduled to be deployed to Afghanistan. He was left partially paralyzed and confined to a wheelchair from being shot by police during his arrest. Under US military law, a US president must approve an execution by firing squad. President Donald Trump did so on Hegseth's recommendation, the Pentagon disclosed on Monday. "It hasn't been since World War Two since we've done that. Well, kind of like the mentality we had in World War Two," Hegseth said. The White House declined to say whether Trump supported the livestreaming, referring questions to the Pentagon. The group Death Penalty Action, which opposes capital punishment, said Hasan's execution would be the first military execution since 1961. According to the Death Penalty Information Center, the 1961 execution was carried out by hanging. The last known executions by US military firing squads were in 1945, the center reported. At least five states have firing squads on the books, according to the Death Penalty Information Center. In 2025, [USN:L2N3PP0X8 TEXT:"South Carolina"] carried out the first such execution in the United States in 15 years. Death by firing squad is one of several forms of capital punishment the Trump administration recently added to permissible forms of execution for the gravest of federal crimes, along with electrocution and gas asphyxiation. The number of federal execution options was expanded in part because of increasing difficulties in obtaining drugs for lethal injections, which have also sometimes proved challenging to carry out. Plans by the state of Tennessee to execute a woman for the first time in more than 200 years went awry last week when prison personnel botched attempts to administer a lethal injection, leaving the death-row inmate, Christa Pike, alive but hospitalized. Her lawyers said on Wednesday she awoke "[USN:L1N45T0M9 TEXT:"angry and confused"]" in a hospital. Pike remains very sick and shackled to her hospital bed, they said.

item.title: NFL backs Supreme Court review in betting oversight case
item.description: The National Football League on Thursday backed New Jersey officials' request for US Supreme Court review of a dispute over whether federal regulators or states should oversee sports-related prediction-market contracts, saying the Commodity Futures Trading Commission may lack resources to adequately police sports betting.
item.dc:creator: Angelica Medina
item.content:encoded: The National Football League on Thursday backed New Jersey officials' request for US Supreme Court review of a dispute over whether federal regulators or states should oversee sports-related prediction-market contracts, saying the Commodity Futures Trading Commission may lack resources to adequately police sports betting. The NFL filed an amicus brief supporting the appeal, urging the court to resolve a split among lower courts over whether the CFTC or state regulators have authority over prediction markets. "The league is joining with many voices to encourage the Court to take this opportunity, now, to resolve the disagreement in the lower courts about who should regulate prediction markets — the CFTC or the states," an NFL spokesperson told Reuters. The NFL said the issue would be less significant if the CFTC adopted protections comparable to those used by state gambling regulators, adding that it was "unclear if the Commission has the resources or staff to adequately regulate sports betting." The league also said it has urged the CFTC and prediction-market companies to adopt safeguards including restrictions on bets susceptible to manipulation, protections against betting by insiders and a minimum age of 21. "Neither the CFTC nor the prediction market companies themselves — despite our persistent urging — have banned categories of bets susceptible to manipulation or set a 21 age limit," the NFL spokesperson said. In a statement to Reuters, the CFTC said it had engaged with the NFL from the beginning. "It's unfortunate the NFL declined to sign an MOU (Memorandum of Understanding) with the CFTC which would've provided the league the ability to better discuss, cooperate, and exchange information with us to promote the integrity and resilience of prediction markets," the agency said. COURT SPLIT PUTS PREDICTION-MARKET OVERSIGHT IN FOCUS The case follows a September 25 ruling by the 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals against prediction-market operator Kalshi, which held that Ohio and Tennessee can regulate its event contracts under their gambling laws. The ruling deepened a split among federal appeals courts and raised the prospect of Supreme Court review. Kalshi said it expected the decision would not withstand further review. "The ruling shows exactly why a state-by-state patchwork doesn't work," company spokesperson Dani Lever [USN:L6N45H114 TEXT:"told Reuters last month"]. "Markets can't operate when the rules change at every state line, which is why Congress created a single federal regulator with nationwide rules." Prediction markets allow users to trade contracts tied to outcomes including sports, elections, weather and cultural events. States have challenged the ability of operators such as Kalshi and Polymarket to offer such contracts without complying with state gambling laws. Kalshi has until November 9 to respond to the petition. The court is not expected to decide whether to hear the case before December. Sports leagues have become increasingly vocal about gambling-related integrity and safety risks as wagering has expanded across the US following the Supreme Court's 2018 decision striking down a federal ban on state-authorized sports betting. Last month,[USN:L6N45717T TEXT:" the NFL and four other major US professional leagues"], along with their players' associations, called on state regulators to impose lifetime betting bans on people who threaten or harass athletes, coaches, officials or their families over wagers.

item.title: Padres ace Michael King has option decision to make
item.description: After an impressive postseason, San Diego Padres right-hander Michael King faces a decision that could determine whether he returns to the team in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: After an impressive postseason, San Diego Padres right-hander Michael King faces a decision that could determine whether he returns to the team in 2027. The 31-year-old has made it clear that he would welcome another season in San Diego. King has two seasons remaining on a three-year, $75 million contract and he holds a player option for each of the remaining seasons. He can either remain with the Padres at a $28 million salary for 2027 or opt out of the deal, accept a $5 million buyout and become a free agent. His 2028 option is worth $30 million. If King opts out, he would join a free-agent pitching class expected to be headlined by left-hander Tarik Skubal. After the Padres ended their season with Wednesday's 3-1 loss to the Milwaukee Brewers in Game 4 of the National League Division Series, King called it a "future decision." But after three seasons with the Padres, more than financial factors are involved. "This is where we started a family," King told reporters after Game 4. "... We started our foundation here. San Diego's been incredible for me, and it's all the way across the country from home. "But now I feel like I have a second home on the West Coast, so it's been awesome. And yeah, I hope to continue." King went 1-0 with a 0.64 ERA in three appearances (two starts) this postseason. He gave up just one hit over seven innings while beating the Chicago Cubs in the NL wild-card series. Against Milwaukee, King gave up one run and three hits over five-plus innings in Game 2. Two days later, he recorded a 40-pitch, two-innings save to help the Padres beat the Brewers in Game 3. In the 2024 playoffs, King struck out 12 and allowed five hits over seven innings in a win over the Atlanta Braves in the wild-card round. King is 30-22 with a 3.15 ERA in 77 starts and one relief appearance during three seasons with the Padres. King was acquired from the Yankees along with four other players in the December 2023 trade that sent Juan Soto to New York. --Field Level Media

item.title: Refresco plots potential IPO at $10 billion-plus valuation, sources say
item.description: Netherlands-based Refresco and its owner KKR took pitches from investment banks in recent weeks for roles on a potential initial public offering of one of the world's largest independent beverage manufacturers, according to people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Abigail Summerville, Echo Wang
item.content:encoded: Netherlands-based Refresco and its owner KKR (KKR.N) took pitches from investment banks in recent weeks for roles on a potential initial public offering of one of the world's largest independent beverage manufacturers, according to people familiar with the matter. Refresco is studying a listing which could happen in either the United States or Europe, with any market debut likely valuing the company at more than $10 billion, the people said, speaking anonymously to discuss confidential matters. The plans are preliminary and could change, the people cautioned. Investment firm KKR acquired the company in 2022 for roughly $8 billion through its global infrastructure strategy, which invests in critical infrastructure assets. Its other investments out of that strategy include utilities, energy and communication services companies. Refresco and KKR declined to comment. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Rotterdam, Netherlands, Refresco works with retailers such as Walmart (WMT.O) and Aldi on their private label beverage products and with branded beverage companies including Coca-Cola (KO.N) , PepsiCo (PEP.O) and Monster Beverage (MNST.O) . Describing itself as the world's largest independent beverage manufacturer, Refresco provides manufacturing, bottling, warehousing, logistics and distribution services to its partners, and has 85 production facilities across North America, Europe and Australia. The company generated close to $7 billion of revenue and around $930 million of adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) in 2025, according to its annual report. Coca-Cola Consolidated (COKE.O) , a North Carolina-headquartered beverage manufacturer, could be a suitable peer to Refresco despite mainly working with Coca-Cola, the sources noted. The company has a roughly $12.5 billion market valuation, and trades at an EBITDA multiple of close to 12 times, per data provider LSEG. The US IPO market had a strong start to the year, with traditional IPOs raising nearly $140 billion so far, according to Dealogic, putting 2026 on pace to approach the record levels of 2021. But market volatility, higher bond yields, rate-hike fears and growing questions over artificial intelligence spending and valuations are threatening to derail what was expected to be a blockbuster fall IPO season. Several companies, [USN:L4N45L0NO TEXT:"including smart-ring maker Oura,"] have delayed planned listings in recent weeks. Still, IPO advisers and investors said companies are continuing to hold pitch meetings with bankers for roles on public offerings — known as bake-offs. They are also continuing to meet informally with investors and otherwise prepare for offerings, seeking to be ready to move quickly when market conditions improve.

item.title: European industry groups call for urgent EU action on China trade
item.description: Forty-four European industry associations urged EU members on Thursday to take immediate action to combat what they said were unfair Chinese trade practices threatening EU manufacturing and risking further job losses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Forty-four European industry associations urged EU members on Thursday to take immediate action to combat what they said were unfair Chinese trade practices threatening EU manufacturing and risking further job losses. The call from the associations representing sectors including metals, chemicals and automotive parts comes a week before EU leaders convene in Brussels to discuss how best to tackle a growing trade deficit with China of more than €1 billion ($1.12 billion) a day. The associations said the European Union should more effectively use all instruments available to impose trade defence measures and adopt a broader approach to look at entire value chains, while avoiding negative impacts on close European partners, such as Britain, Norway and Switzerland. They said the European Commission needed more staff to process complaints more rapidly. They also called for new tools to deal with state-driven distortions. EU leaders at the summit are set to discuss [USN:L6N45R0Q0 TEXT:"Franco-German proposals"] for expanded trade defence published on Monday and European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic's two-day trip to Beijing ending on Friday. Sefcovic is [USN:L6N45T0P1 TEXT:"seeking to persuade China"] to agree to cut exports to the EU in one sector, most likely hybrid vehicles. ($1 = 0.8920 euros)

item.title: Aces star A’ja Wilson wins record fifth MVP award
item.description: Las Vegas Aces star A'ja Wilson became the first five-time MVP in WNBA history Thursday, extending her record with another selection as the league's top player.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las Vegas Aces star A'ja Wilson became the first five-time MVP in WNBA history Thursday, extending her record with another selection as the league's top player. Wilson received 65 of 74 first-place votes, becoming the first player to win three straight MVP awards. Prior to the current streak, she also won in 2020 and 2022. Wilson, 30, averaged 26.2 points to lead the league in scoring for the third straight season. She also averaged 9.4 rebounds, 3.2 assists, 1.9 blocked shots and 1.4 steals in 41 games. Wilson (713 points) also received nine second-place votes. Minnesota rookie point guard Olivia Miles (442) earned six first-place votes to finish second, while Indiana Fever guard Kelsey Mitchell (287 points, two first-place votes) finished third. Indiana guard Caitlin Clark finished fourth with 212 points and one first-place vote, followed by New York Liberty forward Breanna Stewart with 171 points. Wilson was very emotional when she was informed of the award on the Aces' practice court. Later, she reflected on an earlier segment of her life where she never would have guessed "five-time MVP" or "three-time champion" would be labels attached to her name. "When you dream as a young girl, you dream so big and you write your goals out and you just never imagine you will be able to check them off," Wilson said in a press conference. "And when you're able to check them off -- small wins, big wins -- it truly means a lot. I think that's why I cried a little bit harder on this one because 15-year-old A'ja wasn't sitting up here dreaming about being a five-time MVP, she wasn't dreaming about being a three-time champion, she was dreaming about surviving this world. "For me to sit up here surrounded by these trophies and to be able to play the game of basketball every single day, it just means a little bit more to me and it's something I won't take for granted." Wilson, an eight-time All-Star, scored at least 20 points in 33 games, the third-highest single-season streak in WNBA history behind Mitchell's 35 this season and Wilson's 34 in 2024. Wilson also tied the WNBA single-season record she set in 2025 with 13 games of at least 30 points. The Aces, winners of three of the past four WNBA championships, face elimination Friday night when they host the Golden State Valkyries in Game 3 of their best-of-five semifinal series. Golden State holds a 2-0 lead. --Field Level Media

item.title: Storm Simon seen exploding into major hurricane before hitting Mexico
item.description: Tropical Storm Simon is forecast to rapidly strengthen into a major hurricane before striking Mexico's Pacific coast this weekend, threatening destructive winds, life-threatening flooding and dangerous storm surge, the US National Hurricane Center said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tropical Storm Simon is forecast to rapidly strengthen into a major hurricane before striking Mexico's Pacific coast this weekend, threatening destructive winds, life-threatening flooding and dangerous storm surge, the US National Hurricane Center said on Thursday. Simon was about 245 miles (395 km) south of Manzanillo at midday, with maximum sustained winds of 65 mph (100 kph), the Miami-based center said. It was moving west at 5 mph and is expected to turn northward on Friday, approaching southwestern and west-central Mexico late on Saturday. The hurricane center said Simon was likely to become a hurricane later on Thursday and intensify into a "very dangerous" Category 4 hurricane before reaching the coast. A hurricane watch was in effect from the port city of Manzanillo to vacation hotspot Punta Mita. Forecasters warned Simon could dump 8 to 15 inches (20 to 38 cm) of rain across parts of southwestern Mexico through Sunday, with isolated totals of up to 25 inches (64 cm) possible in the states of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco. The rainfall could trigger life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in mountainous areas. A dangerous storm surge was also possible near and east of where the storm's center makes landfall, the center said, with large and destructive waves expected along the coast. Swells generated by Simon were forecast to create hazardous surf and rip current conditions over the coming days. Private forecaster AccuWeather said Simon could make landfall in western Mexico on Sunday with wind gusts of 120 to 130 mph (193 to 209 kph) near the point of impact and storm surge of up to 15 feet (4.6 meters) in the worst-hit areas. It said some of the same regions affected by Hurricane Polo late last month were now facing another tropical threat. AccuWeather also said tropical moisture from Simon could spread into the US Southwest next week, bringing 1 to 2 inches (2.5 to 5 cm) of rain to parts of New Mexico, eastern Arizona, southern Colorado and western Texas, with higher totals possible in southern New Mexico.

item.title: Most Medicare Advantage drug plan enrollees in high-quality plans, US government says
item.description: The US government said on Thursday that about 71% of Medicare Advantage prescription drug plan enrollees are currently in contracts that will have quality ratings of four stars or higher in 2027, a measure aimed at helping consumers compare health plans.
item.dc:creator: Amina Niasse, Sahil Pandey
item.content:encoded: The US government said on Thursday that about 71% of Medicare Advantage prescription drug plan enrollees are currently in contracts that will have quality ratings of four stars or higher in 2027, a measure aimed at helping consumers compare health plans. The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, part of the US Department of Health and Human Services, rates Medicare Advantage and prescription drug plans on a scale of one to five stars, with five stars indicating the highest quality. Higher ratings lead to bonus payments from the government that collectively amount to billions of dollars and boost plan enrollment. About 95% of Humana members were enrolled in plans that scored four stars or higher, according to an Oppenheimer calculation, a 53% improvement compared with the year prior. Oppenheimer analyst Michael Wiederhorn said improved scores could add $3.6 billion for Humana in revenue and provide greater visibility into future earnings. Average ratings for UnitedHealth and CVS declined 15% from the year prior, Wiederhorn said, while Elevance and Centene fell 10% and 9%, respectively. Shares of Humana (HUM.N) rose about 14% in extended trading, while those of UnitedHealth and CVS Health (CVS.N) fell about 0.5% and 4%, respectively. The government posted a low performance warning for a California-based prescription drug plan operated by CVS Health's Aetna insurance unit. Aetna President Steve Nelson said the company's performance ratings reflected progress in its clinical services and improved health outcomes for members. UnitedHealth Group (UNH.N) , one of the largest providers of Medicare Advantage plans in the United States, said the ratings were in line with its expectations. The companies operate government-backed Medicare Advantage plans for adults aged 65 and older and people with disabilities. CMS will pay insurers over $13 billion in bonus payments in 2026, according to data from health policy research firm KFF. CMS also said about 37% of Medicare Advantage prescription drug contracts that will be offered in 2027 earned four stars or higher for their overall rating. The ratings are designed to help beneficiaries compare plans based on factors such as customer satisfaction, access to care and management of chronic conditions. Five-star plans attract more members and can enroll new ones round the year. The 2027 ratings will be displayed during Medicare open enrollment, which runs from October 15 through December 7, and will affect 2028 Medicare Advantage quality bonus payments. UnitedHealthcare and Aetna can offset reductions in bonus payments with membership changes and private health plans the companies operate, Oppenheimer's Wiederhorn said. A spokesperson for Humana did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. "These results provide a strong foundation for further progress and we look forward to working with CMS as it modernizes the Star Ratings program," a spokesperson for UnitedHealthcare said.

item.title: OpenAI's annualized revenue $20 billion less than previously signaled, FT reports
item.description: OpenAI's annualized revenue is about $20 billion less than has been previously signaled, the Financial Times reported on Thursday, citing financial documents shared with investors.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: OpenAI's annualized revenue is about $20 billion less than has been previously signaled, the Financial Times reported on Thursday, citing financial documents shared with investors. OpenAI did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Reuters could not independently verify the report. Here are some details: The company has recently told investors its revenue was approaching $50 billion on an annualized basis at the end of September, the report said, far short of the [USN:L4N45L1EC TEXT:"$70 billion reported by"] media outlets, including Reuters, late last month The discrepancy arose from attempts by OpenAI's own investors to produce a direct comparison with Anthropic's annualized revenue, the FT reported, citing a person with knowledge of the matter The pair calculate the figure in different ways, with Anthropic including the revenue from sales via cloud partners such as AWS and Google Cloud, while OpenAI does not, the Financial Times report said Annualized revenue run rate is sometimes misleading sales metric, which often involves multiplying one month's revenue by 12, but it has nonetheless become a popular metric commonly used by fast-growing Silicon Valley startups OpenAI and its rival Anthropic are potentially preparing to go public, which could give Wall Street a clearer view of their finances, including the sustainability of their rapid revenue growth due to the AI boom

item.title: RTX's Raytheon wins up to $6.3 billion US missile contract
item.description: RTX's Raytheon said on Thursday it won a multi-year US military contract worth up to $6.3 billion to produce and sustain Standard Missile-3 Block IB interceptors, as the Pentagon seeks to rebuild missile-defence inventories and boost munitions production.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: RTX's Raytheon said on Thursday it won a multi-year US military contract worth up to $6.3 billion to produce and sustain Standard Missile-3 Block IB interceptors, as the Pentagon seeks to rebuild missile-defence inventories and boost munitions production. The award comes as the Pentagon looks to replenish stockpiles depleted by conflicts in the Middle East and meet growing demand for air and missile defence systems. The Standard Missile-3 Block IB is a ballistic missile-defence interceptor used by the U.S. Navy against short- and intermediate-range ballistic missile threats. The deal follows a series of large Pentagon missile contracts. In October, Raytheon secured a contract worth up to [USN:L1N45N15T TEXT:"$24.4 billion"] to produce Standard Missile-6 interceptors for the U.S. Navy, while Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) won a $58.6 billion Patriot missile contract in July. The agreements are part of the Trump administration's push to expand U.S. weapons production by encouraging contractors to increase manufacturing capacity. Industry executives, however, have warned that a lack of congressional funding could delay investment in facilities and supply chains. Raytheon said it has invested in expanding production capacity for the Standard Missile family. Work under the contract will be performed primarily at its facilities in Tucson, Arizona, and Huntsville, Alabama.

item.title: Peso mexicano lidera pérdidas cambiarias tras minuta Banxico, bolsa retoma senda positiva

item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano registró el jueves el peor desempeño entre una cesta de monedas principales, después de que la minuta de la más reciente reunión del [USN:L1N45U0OW TEXT:"Banco de México"] abrió la puerta a posibles recortes de la tasa clave de interés si la inflación continúa cediendo. La perspectiva de menores rendimientos en México amenaza con reducir el diferencial frente a Estados Unidos, en un contexto en el que se espera que la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] (Fed) siga elevando el costo de los créditos, restando atractivo a las operaciones de carry trade que durante años han apuntalado a la divisa local. * La moneda cotizaba en 18.1950 unidades hacia el cierre de los negocios, con una pérdida del 1.2%, pese a que el [USN:L1N45U0UR TEXT:"dólar estadounidense"] cedió impulso durante la sesión a medida que se moderó una subida de los rendimientos de los bonos de la zona euro. * Según la minuta, tres de los cinco miembros de la [USN:L1N45U0OW TEXT:"junta de gobierno"] de Banxico consideraron que podrían evaluarse futuros recortes de tasas si mejora el panorama inflacionario. Aun así, los funcionarios señalaron que el balance de riesgos para la inflación sigue sesgado al alza. * Datos publicados por la mañana mostraron que el [USN:L1N45U0FT TEXT:"índice general de precios al consumidor"] se aceleró en septiembre, aunque menos de lo previsto. El componente subyacente, en tanto, continuó moderándose, pero se mantuvo en la parte alta del rango objetivo. * El peso ha estado bajo presión desde que la Fed elevó su tasa a mediados de septiembre y anticipó nuevos ajustes, mientras que Banxico mantuvo la suya sin cambios y descartó responder mecánicamente a los movimientos de la autoridad estadounidense. * En medio de las turbulencias, la moneda llegó a negociarse durante el día en 18.23 unidades por dólar y analistas no descartan que podría seguir bajo presión. * "Mi lectura inicial es que el sesgo sigue siendo alcista mientras respete la zona de 17.90–18.00, con una primera resistencia relevante entre 18.23 y 18.46 pesos", dijo Humberto Calzada, economista jefe de Rankia Latinoamérica. * La bolsa mexicana, por su parte, retomó la tendencia positiva de las últimas jornadas, que fue interrumpida el miércoles por un ajuste de posiciones, mientras los inversores se preparan para el próximo inicio de la temporada de reportes corporativos del tercer trimestre. * El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) subió un 0.52% a 64,986.91 puntos, con lo que recuperó parte de la caída del 1% registrada el miércoles. * Las acciones de la embotelladora Coca-Cola FEMSA (KOFUBL.MX) encabezaron las alzas, con un avance del 3.21% a 199.72 pesos, seguidas por los títulos de su matriz, la también minorista FEMSA (FEMSAUBD.MX) , que sumaron un 2.88% a 216.60 pesos. * En el mercado secundario de deuda, el rendimiento del bono gubernamental a 10 años cayó siete puntos básicos a un 9.32%, mientras que la tasa a 20 años descendió cinco puntos base, a 9.76%.

Mexican peso biggest decliner in global FX, -1.3% on inflation, cenbank minutes. BONDS: UK gilt yields at [USN:S8N42Q0DU TEXT:"19-year high"], Italian yields 3-year high but euro spreads tighten. US yields fall up to 6 bps at long end after strong 30-year auction, curve flattens most in 3 weeks. COMMODITIES/METALS: [USN:L6N45U00Z TEXT:"Oil"] +4%, largely ignoring Trump's Iran pledge. Brent has best day in a month.

Today's Talking Points: Reality check US tech and AI stocks sank on Thursday after the FT reported that OpenAI's annualized revenues are $20 billion lower than the $70 billion previously signaled. It appears that there is a difference between how OpenAi and Anthropic book revenues in their accounts, which goes a long way to explaining the discrepancy. However, it also gets to the heart of investors' concerns about the AI buildout, namely the borrowing, off-balance sheet debt, circular financing, and ultimately, future returns. With trillions on the table, and stock prices and concentration at record highs, markets are vulnerable to reports like this. Especially regarding OpenAI which, along with Anthropic, is one of the most important parts in the whole AI story. Scores on the doors Thursday's US 30-year bond auction wrapped up a week that saw Treasury sell nearly $120 billion of 3-, 10- and 30-year debt. The long bond sale cleared at 5.618%, reportedly the highest since 2000, but demand was strong - the bid/cover ratio of 2.54 was one of the highest in the last decade, primary dealers' takedown was low, and indirect bidders - a proxy for foreign central banks - took up a high share. Overall, this week's sales went much better than the 2-7 year auctions two weeks ago, in which the 5-year sale was particularly bad. The highest yields since the 2000s attracted buyers, and the question now is whether the selloff is over. Some market participants on Thursday mischievously pointed to the front cover of The Economist, sometimes seen as a contrarian indicator, as a signal that it is. The latest cover asks the question: 'Will bonds blow up?' Tariff impact on inflation Were it not for President Donald Trump's tariffs, US consumer goods' prices would have fallen. As it was, however, they rose due to the tariffs, which had added nearly 3 percentage points to goods price inflation as of February this year. So says the authors of a New York Fed paper published this week, in which they studied a sample basket of 67 goods. The good news? The pass through has likely faded by now and base effects mean the tariff contribution will be negative through the middle of next year. Among the other takeaways, around a quarter of a tariff increase is passed through to goods prices, although the indirect effect on goods made in the US takes longer to materialize, so the full effect of a tariff takes about a year to appear. What could move markets tomorrow? item.title: Depois de cobrança de aliados, PT amplia participação de Alckmin em campanha
item.description: Discreto até agora na sua participação na campanha eleitoral, o vice-presidente Geraldo Alckmin ganhará mais espaço nesse segundo turno, depois de cobrança de aliados por uma presença sua mais forte não apenas em atos, mas na própria propaganda eleitoral.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: Discreto até agora na sua participação na campanha eleitoral, o vice-presidente Geraldo Alckmin ganhará mais espaço nesse segundo turno, depois de cobrança de aliados por uma presença sua mais forte não apenas em atos, mas na própria propaganda eleitoral. "Esquecido" no primeiro turno, Alckmin fez poucos atos sozinho, sem Lula, e também não participou das inserções eleitorais. Agora, com Lula ainda se concentrando em gravações e reuniões internas de coordenação, a agenda já está cheia. A cobrança por uma participação mais ativa do vice-presidente já vem de antes do primeiro turno, mas aumentou depois que Flávio Bolsonaro ficou quase 2 pontos percentuais à frente do presidente na votação de domingo. A avaliação dos aliados é que Alckmin tem capacidade de atrair um eleitor moderado que não quer votar em Flávio, mas não sente confiança em Lula. Da mesma forma, Alckmin teria esse espaço com o mercado financeiro. Oriundo do PSDB, o vice, mesmo tendo se aliado com o PT, é visto mais favoravelmente pelo mercado. Até agora, no entanto, o PT havia deixado essa interlocução com o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan. Como mostrou a Reuters, Alckmin é mesmo cotado para assumir o Ministério da Fazenda em um eventual novo mandato de Lula, o que é considerado um sinal de estabilidade fiscal. AGENDA POPULAR E MERCADO FINANCEIRO O vice-presidente gravou inserções eleitorais na quarta-feira e também fez uma visita à feira de Ceilândia, maior cidade-satélite do Distrito Federal, com Leandro Grass, candidato do PT ao governo do DF, que disputa o segundo turno. Nesta quinta, foi à comunidade de Paraisópolis, em São Paulo. Nas duas participações, fez um tipo de campanha que Lula não tem feito, até pelas dificuldades de ser presidente: caminhar nas ruas, tirar fotos, postar vídeos. O vice ainda deve ter outra agenda popular no próximo domingo: participar de uma manifestação organizada pela União Nacional dos Estudantes (UNE) na Avenida Paulista. Alckmin também deve assumir dois outros papéis nesse segundo turno, de acordo com fontes ouvidas pela Reuters: o contato com comunidades religiosas e com empresários e representantes do mercado financeiro. Ainda que católico fervoroso, o vice-presidente tem boa relação com religiosos de diferentes matizes, e sua agenda já está tomada de eventos do tipo. Na noite desta quinta, participa de uma live com católicos chamada "Plenária Povo de Deus com a Democracia"; no sábado, grava uma sabatina com evangélicos e ainda participa de um evento de apoio à chapa presidencial organizado pelo grupo Judias e Judeus pela Democracia, em São Paulo. No dia 12, como faz há 40 anos, Alckmin irá a Aparecida, participar da missa na Basílica pelo dia da Padroeira.

item.title: Kremlin: Russia agrees with Rubio that Ukraine conflict is in a stalemate
item.description: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov was quoted as saying on Thursday that Russia agreed with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that the Ukraine conflict was in a stalemate.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov was quoted as saying on Thursday that Russia agreed with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio that the Ukraine conflict was in a [USN:L1N45U0GU TEXT:"stalemate"]. "Yes, we agree with him," Russian news agencies quoted Peskov as saying on the sidelines of a meeting of leaders of ex-Soviet states in Turkmenistan. State news agency RIA quoted Peskov as saying it was up to diplomats to find ways of moving towards peace. "The art of diplomacy precisely involves finding some way out that would allow moving onto a peaceful track," Peskov was quoted as saying. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will meet Ukrainian representatives on Friday in Miami to discuss new ideas and try to produce a unified proposal for resolving the war, an American source familiar with the plan [USN:L1N45U0VZ TEXT:"said"] on Thursday. Peskov was quoted as saying he saw no immediate prospect for a three-way summit between Putin, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy and US President Donald Trump. He restated the Kremlin's position that Russia wanted an overall solution to the conflict and was not interested in temporary measures, like a limited ceasefire. "We are not for a fragmented solution, we are for a comprehensive solution that will allow for sustainable settlement for many, many years, for decades," the agencies quoted him as saying.

item.title: Petróleo sobe 4% com temores sobre Oriente Médio e impacto do furacão Isaias
item.description: Os preços do petróleo fecharam com alta de 4% nesta quinta-feira, devido ao ressurgimento das preocupações com a guerra em curso no Oriente Médio e às crescentes interrupções no abastecimento causadas por um furacão que se aproxima da costa do Golfo dos Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Arathy Somasekhar
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo fecharam com alta de 4% nesta quinta-feira, devido ao ressurgimento das preocupações com a guerra em curso no Oriente Médio e às crescentes interrupções no abastecimento causadas por um furacão que se aproxima da costa do Golfo dos Estados Unidos. Os futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam com alta de US$4,08, ou 4,1%, a US$104,28, enquanto o petróleo West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos subiu 3,6%, ou US$3,21, para US$91,49. Mais cedo, em determinado momento, ambos os contratos registraram alta de mais de US$5 por barril, com o Brent atingindo seu maior nível desde 29 de setembro devido a preocupações com possíveis ataques dos Estados Unidos ao Irã e à previsão de que o furacão Isaias atinja o continente na sexta-feira. Os preços recuaram de suas máximas depois que o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou que Washington estava mantendo discussões produtivas com o Irã e prometeu não atacar o país até depois das eleições intermediárias de 3 de novembro nos EUA. A agência de notícias iraniana Tasnim informou que o ministro das Relações Exteriores, Abbas Araqchi, disse que Teerã está analisando a resposta dos EUA à sua proposta de reabrir o Estreito de Ormuz em até sete dias, afirmando que responderá nos próximos dias. No entanto, os EUA impuseram novas sanções ao Irã nesta quinta-feira, visando indivíduos, redes e 17 embarcações pelo transporte de petróleo, derivados de petróleo e produtos petroquímicos iranianos, informou o Departamento do Treasury, em um esforço para aumentar a pressão econômica sobre Teerã. A França e a Arábia Saudita estão analisando várias opções envolvendo recursos militares franceses para ajudar a proteger o terminal petrolífero de Yanbu, afirmou nesta quinta-feira o chefe do Estado-Maior das Forças Armadas da França, general Fabien Mandon. A Síria também estava considerando fornecer assistência militar à Arábia Saudita, seu principal aliado, no conflito com os houthis, apoiados pelo Irã, no Iêmen, disseram uma autoridade norte-americana e um oficial militar sírio a par do assunto. As opções em consideração incluem ajuda defensiva ou o envio de forças em caráter ofensivo para ajudar as tropas iemenitas apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita, afirmaram as fontes.

item.title: Commanders waive rookie RB Kaytron Allen
item.description: The Washington Commanders on Thursday waived running back Kaytron Allen, who was a sixth-round draft pick this past April.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Washington Commanders on Thursday waived running back Kaytron Allen, who was a sixth-round draft pick this past April. Allen, 23, saw snaps in each of Washington's four games so far and rushed 12 times for 41 yards. He also appeared on special teams. However, the Commanders brought back veteran Austin Ekeler earlier this season to complement starter Jacory Croskey-Merritt and No. 2 back Rachaad White, who have gotten the bulk of the work in Washington's backfield. Allen starred for four seasons at Penn State, where he never rushed for fewer than 867 yards. He finished his college career with 769 attempts for 4,180 rushing yards and 39 touchdowns, along with 70 receptions for 490 yards and four TDs. He earned second-team All-America honors from the AFCA in 2025, when he racked up 1,303 rushing yards and 15 touchdowns. --Field Level Media

item.title: American Express fined $350 million for insufficient anti-money laundering program
item.description: American Express was fined $350 million by US bank regulators after they determined the lender's programs to identify potential money laundering were insufficient and the company potentially missed billions of dollars in suspicious activity.
item.dc:creator: Pete Schroeder, Chris Prentice
item.content:encoded: American Express was fined $350 million by US bank regulators after they determined the lender's programs to identify potential money laundering were insufficient and the company potentially missed billions of dollars in suspicious activity. The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency and the Federal Reserve announced the enforcement action Thursday, saying the company, primarily via its national bank, failed to maintain a sufficient anti-money laundering compliance program, including inadequate resources, inexperienced staff, weak training, and internal control gaps. A spokesperson for American Express, which did not admit or deny the regulators' findings, did not respond immediately to a request for comment. The OCC said "systemic breakdowns" in its monitoring and reporting meant the lender failed to identify, evaluate and sufficiently report roughly $13 billion in suspicious activity over the past decade. "The OCC expects banks of American Express’s size and complexity to devote sufficient resources to ensure compliance with laws and regulations designed to detect and prevent money laundering, which are critical to both economic and national security,” said Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould in a statement. Specifically, the OCC said American Express focused on risks in its relatively narrow deposit products, while not devoting sufficient attention to its much larger credit card business. The regulator also identified shortcomings in customer due diligence and identification programs.

item.title: Chuvas reduzem potencial da safra de trigo do RS, afirma Emater
item.description: Uma sequência de chuvas, elevada umidade, baixa luminosidade e a ocorrência de granizo e ventos fortes prejudicaram o potencial produtivo da safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul em 2026, afirmou nesta quinta-feira a Emater, em boletim semanal.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Uma sequência de chuvas, elevada umidade, baixa luminosidade e a ocorrência de granizo e ventos fortes prejudicaram o potencial produtivo da safra de trigo do Rio Grande do Sul em 2026, afirmou nesta quinta-feira a Emater, em boletim semanal. "No centro-oeste e noroeste do Estado, os eventos meteorológicos no período provocaram acamamento, debulha de espigas e perdas de estruturas reprodutivas em áreas atingidas por granizo, reduzindo as expectativas inicialmente projetadas para a safra", afirmou o órgão de assistência técnica do Rio Grande do Sul. O Estado poderia ser o principal produtor de trigo do Brasil em 2026, com uma produção de 2,2 milhões de toneladas, segundo a estatal Conab. A Emater não divulgou uma nova projeção. Esse volume já implicaria em uma redução de 36,8% na comparação com a temporada passada, por diminuição na área plantada e menores produtividades estimadas. Produtores plantaram menos por questões de mercado e também cautela diante do El Niño, que geralmente traz chuvas excessivas para o Sul do país. Com a quebra de safra, também registrada no Paraná, o Brasil deverá elevar importações do cereal neste ciclo. Em nota nesta semana, a Associação Brasileira da Indústria do Trigo (Abitrigo) afirmou que as compras externas podem se aproximar de 9 milhões de toneladas no ciclo atual, acima da projeção inicial de 7,5 milhões. A Conab [USN:L1N44A11V TEXT:"alertou"] já em agosto sobre patamares elevados de importações pelo Brasil. Nas lavouras em maturação, acrescentou a Emater, a continuidade das chuvas também aumentou a preocupação com os parâmetros de qualidade do produto, especialmente quanto à redução do peso hectolitro (PH) e à atividade enzimática associada à germinação pré-colheita. A elevada umidade durante o período reprodutivo favoreceu a incidência de doenças fúngicas como giberela, manchas foliares, ferrugens, oídio e de outras doenças, disse a Emater. A colheita de trigo avançou esta semana para 4% da área total plantada com o cereal no Estado. As lavouras apresentam avanço expressivo para as fases finais do ciclo, predominando as de enchimento de grãos (60%) e de maturação (27%), segundo o boletim.

item.title: Novo Congresso representa risco para a legislação ambiental, diz Observatório do Clima
item.description: O próximo Congresso brasileiro provavelmente representará um obstáculo ainda maior para a legislação de proteção ambiental após as eleições deste mês, mostrou um estudo do Observatório do Clima, apontando que quase 70% dos parlamentares eleitos têm pouco ou nenhum comprometimento com questões ambientais.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: O próximo Congresso brasileiro provavelmente representará um obstáculo ainda maior para a legislação de proteção ambiental após as eleições deste mês, mostrou um estudo do Observatório do Clima, apontando que quase 70% dos parlamentares eleitos têm pouco ou nenhum comprometimento com questões ambientais. O estudo analisou projetos de lei, propostas legislativas, discursos e declarações públicas de parlamentares novos e reeleitos e concluiu que 64 dos 81 membros do Senado têm um histórico de comprometimento "muito baixo" ou "baixo" com questões ambientais. Na Câmara dos Deputados, 345 dos 511 parlamentares foram classificados na mesma categoria. O Partido Liberal, sigla do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (RJ) -- que enfrentará o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva no segundo turno das eleições presidenciais ainda neste mês --, é o que tem menor comprometimento com as questões ambientais dentre as principais legendas, segundo o estudo. Todos os 28 senadores do partido eleitos no domingo, assim como os deputados eleitos, foram classificados como tendo um comprometimento muito baixo nesta área. Outros partidos de direita, incluindo Novo, Republicanos, Progressistas e União Brasil, também apresentaram baixo apoio a causas ambientais, afirmou o estudo. Defensores do meio ambiente podem enfrentar um cenário político mais desafiador com a inclinação do Congresso ainda mais à direita e caso Flávio Bolsonaro -- cujos comentários sobre mudanças climáticas já causam preocupação -- seja eleito presidente, afirmou o Observatório do Clima. A Reuters entrou em contato com os partidos mencionados, mas não obteve resposta. Propostas que podem enfraquecer as proteções ambientais, incluindo medidas para reduzir áreas protegidas, permitir a mineração em terras indígenas e facilitar os requisitos de licenciamento ambiental, podem ganhar força sob o novo Congresso, acrescentou o grupo. "Este quadro evidencia quatro anos de muito esforço para aqueles que atuam em clima e meio ambiente, e muita preocupação tanto com graves retrocessos quanto com as terríveis consequências disso tudo para a crise climática. Somando com um governo negacionista de Flávio Bolsonaro, isso significará o caos ambienta", disse Suely Araújo , coordenadora de políticas públicas do Observatório.

item.title: New ‘Bridgerton’ series to follow young Violet and Edmund Bridgerton romance
item.description: A new “Bridgerton” limited television series centered on a younger version of Violet Bridgerton is in the works, Netflix and Shondaland announced on Instagram on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Broadway
item.content:encoded: A new “Bridgerton” limited television series centered on a younger version of Violet Bridgerton is in the works, Netflix (NFLX.O) and Shondaland announced on Instagram on Thursday. "The time has come for us to turn our attention to the Matriarch of our beloved Bridgertons," the social media post said, referring to Violet Bridgerton, who has been portrayed by English actress Ruth Gemmell across the first four seasons of the Netflix series. "A new series, chronicling the romance of a young Violet and Viscount Edmund Bridgerton, is underway," the post added. The not-yet-titled limited series marks the latest spin-off in the “Bridgerton” universe. Shonda Rhimes and Nicholas Nardini, a producer on the previous "Bridgerton" spin-off series “Queen Charlotte,” will serve as showrunners, writers and executive producers on the new show. The Regency-era romance franchise is based on the "Bridgerton" books by Julia Quinn, with each installment focusing on a different Bridgerton sibling's romance. Season 5 of “Bridgerton” is currently in production in London and will center on Francesca Bridgerton, played by Hannah Dodd, and Michaela Stirling, played by Masali Baduza. "Bridgerton" became a global phenomenon when it debuted in 2020 and won praise for its diverse cast.

item.title: Ucrânia espera que europeus participem das negociações com os EUA, diz Zelenskiy
item.description: O presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy afirmou nesta quinta-feira que a Ucrânia espera que os parceiros europeus de Kiev participem das negociações com os Estados Unidos nos próximos dias.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy afirmou nesta quinta-feira que a Ucrânia espera que os parceiros europeus de Kiev participem das negociações com os Estados Unidos nos próximos dias. Anteriormente, Zelenskiy havia dito que os negociadores da Ucrânia iriam ter conversas nos Estados Unidos na sexta-feira e no sábado, como parte dos esforços liderados pelos norte-americanos para buscar um acordo para a guerra com a Rússia, que já dura quatro anos e meio. Em declarações à imprensa em Kiev, o presidente ucraniano disse que os negociadores do país devem levantar a questão das defesas aéreas diante dos ataques russos quase constantes contra cidades ucranianas. Mais de 70 pessoas foram mortas em ataques nos últimos dois dias. Zelenskiy também disse que a Ucrânia havia “retribuído” os ataques russos a data centers, referindo-se a um ataque a instalações da empresa de tecnologia russa Yandex. “Sempre respondemos de forma espelhada”, disse Zelenskiy. “Todos vocês sabem que eles têm atacado e continuam atacando nossos data centers. Estamos respondendo. Não posso compartilhar todos os detalhes.” A empresa russa de tecnologia e IA Yandex informou nesta quinta-feira que ainda não é possível determinar se os equipamentos de um data center atingido por um ataque com drones ucranianos poderiam ser restaurados.

item.title: Operarios de mina chilena Centinela mantienen huelga; dicen impacto en producción se verá en noviembre
item.description: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos de la mina de cobre chilena Centinela sumaban el jueves una segunda jornada de su huelga y aseguraron que el impacto de la paralización de operadores clave se evidenciará plenamente en noviembre, dijeron los sindicatos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los trabajadores de dos sindicatos de la mina de cobre chilena Centinela sumaban el jueves una segunda jornada de su huelga y aseguraron que el impacto de la paralización de operadores clave se evidenciará plenamente en noviembre, dijeron los sindicatos. Los agremiados iniciaron el miércoles la paralización tras fracasar su negociación contractual con Antofagasta Minerals, lo que pone presión a los precios globales del cobre en momentos en que la industria está afectada por problemas operativos, eventos naturales y bajas leyes de mineral. "El efecto de la huelga en la producción de cobre se irá incrementando progresivamente, al necesitar Centinela mover una gran cantidad de lastre para alcanzar el mineral", dijeron los gremios en un comunicado. El efecto en la producción de cobre se evidenciará a plenitud en noviembre, con una disminución de cerca del 50%", agregaron. Los sindicatos afirman contar con sobre el 50% de los operadores de mina críticos, como operadores de pala y perforadoras, y sobre el 60% de los mantenedores de equipos de mina. Ambas partes han afirmado estar dispuestas a buscar una solución, pero los sindicatos insisten en que la empresa no ha planteado una solución a su demanda principal, que es que todos los trabajadores reciban el mismo nivel de beneficios independiente del sindicato al que se encuentren afiliados. Antofagasta -que ofreció bonos finales y préstamo blando por el equivalente de unos 26.400 dólares por socio y un ajuste del sueldo base del 2%- dijo el miércoles que desde 2020 los calendarios de negociación se separaron y los incrementos se acordaron en momentos diferentes.

item.title: CME expands sports derivatives push with baseball futures
item.description: Derivatives exchange CME said on Thursday it would launch the world's first baseball futures.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Derivatives exchange CME (CME.O) said on Thursday it would launch the world's first baseball futures. Here are some more details: The contracts will track CME FutureSports Performance Indexes covering statistics from 30 professional baseball teams. Trading is set to begin October 12, pending regulatory review, starting with the 2026 postseason and four clubs in the League Championship Series. "We see an opportunity to bring investing and hedging discipline to the business of professional baseball," Tim McCourt, CME's senior managing director and global head of equities, FX and alternative products, said. The derivatives exchange also [USN:L4N4481CA TEXT:"launched"] the world's first index-based hockey futures in August. CME [USN:L4N43V15Y TEXT:"partnered"] with FutureSports in July to develop derivatives linked to professional and college sports, offering an alternative to event-based contracts traded on prediction markets. US exchanges and prediction markets have looked to bring popular cultural and emerging economic themes into financial markets, creating new instruments for businesses and investors.

item.title: Anthropic lança painel de controle e ferramentas de animação para Claude
item.description: A Anthropic lançou nesta quinta-feira ferramentas que permitem aos usuários criar painéis de dados e animações por meio do chatbot Claude.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Anthropic lançou nesta quinta-feira ferramentas que permitem aos usuários criar painéis de dados e animações por meio do chatbot Claude. O Claude Dashboards, disponível em versão beta para planos pagos, conecta-se a plataformas de dados empresariais e sistemas de gestão de clientes, permitindo que os usuários criem painéis em tempo real e análises a partir de consultas em linguagem natural. O Claude Motion, em versão beta para clientes dos planos Team e Enterprise, permite que os usuários criem animações editáveis e as exportem como arquivos de vídeo. A Anthropic afirmou que as ferramentas têm como objetivo ajudar os usuários a analisarem dados empresariais e criarem conteúdo visual sem precisarem programar. A empresa também disponibilizou suas ferramentas Claude Docs, Slides e Design para todos os planos do Claude após os testes beta. (Por Prathik Jayaprakash)

item.title: Moraes determina que Eduardo Bolsonaro comece a cumprir pena
item.description: O ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), determinou que o ex-deputado Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) comece a cumprir pena após ter sido condenado por coação no curso do processo por sua atuação a favor da imposição de tarifas e sanções por parte do governo dos Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), determinou que o ex-deputado Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) comece a cumprir pena após ter sido condenado por coação no curso do processo por sua atuação a favor da imposição de tarifas e sanções por parte do governo dos Estados Unidos. No despacho, visto pela Reuters nesta quinta-feira, Moraes ordenou uma série de providências, como a expedição de um mandado de prisão para cumprimento da pena de quatro anos e dois meses de prisão em regime inicialmente semiaberto e também o cancelamento do passaporte do ex-deputado. Eduardo Bolsonaro, que reside nos EUA desde o início do ano passado, foi condenado pela Primeira Turma do Supremo por ter articulado nos Estados Unidos retaliações do governo do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, contra o Brasil e autoridades brasileiras com o objetivo de tentar influenciar no julgamento que levou o seu pai, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro (PL), a ser condenado pelo tribunal por tentativa de golpe de Estado, entre outros crimes. Em nota à imprensa, o ex-parlamentar chamou a ordem de Moraes de "arbitrária, inoportuna e inócua, uma vez que os Estados Unidos já deixaram claro que não cumprem decisões delirantes dessa natureza". "O único efeito prático desse ato, tomado deliberadamente no meio do processo eleitoral, é acirrar ainda mais, e sem nenhuma necessidade, os ânimos do país", acrescentou. Eduardo tem sido cotado para assumir um eventual Ministério das Relações Exteriores caso o irmão dele, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-SP), seja eleito no segundo turno para a Presidência da República.

item.title: S&P 500 e Nasdaq fecham em baixa com alta nos preços do petróleo; ações de chips pesam
item.description: As ações nos EUA caíram nesta quinta-feira, à medida que os preços do petróleo bruto dispararam devido a um aumento repentino das tensões no Oriente Médio e a um corte na produção dos EUA, o que alimentou temores de inflação e de aumento das taxas de juros, enquanto as ações do setor de chips tombaram.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: As ações nos EUA caíram nesta quinta-feira, à medida que os preços do petróleo bruto dispararam devido a um aumento repentino das tensões no Oriente Médio e a um corte na produção dos EUA, o que alimentou temores de inflação e de aumento das taxas de juros, enquanto as ações do setor de chips tombaram. Entre os principais índices acionários dos EUA, o Nasdaq fechou com a maior queda percentual, dois dias depois que o índice, de forte presença do setor de tecnologia, atingiu um recorde no fechamento. A queda do S&P 500 foi mais modesta, enquanto o Dow Jones, índice de blue chips, registrou um ganho nominal. As fabricantes de chips (.SOX) , que subiram mais de 80% neste ano, tiveram um desempenho claramente inferior no dia, caindo 3,4% após uma reportagem do Financial Times que afirmou que as receitas anualizadas da OpenAI eram US$20 bilhões menores do que a empresa havia sinalizado anteriormente. “O mercado está em consolidação, na expectativa da temporada de resultados do terceiro trimestre, que começa na próxima semana, e há também o conflito em curso no Irã, que está elevando os preços do petróleo”, disse Terry Sandven, estrategista-chefe de ações do US Bank Wealth Management, em Minneapolis, Minnesota. “O que é igualmente revelador é que, no acumulado do ano, a trajetória de menor resistência para as ações tem sido de alta.” Os preços do petróleo saltaram devido a preocupações com a oferta, após uma série de ataques a navios no Estreito de Ormuz, combinados com uma redução na produção dos EUA devido à atividade de furacões. O WTI e o Brent fecharam em alta de 3,6% e 4,1%, respectivamente. A escassez global de petróleo bruto durante a guerra no Irã fez com que o petróleo bruto dos EUA disparasse mais de 60% neste ano, alimentando as pressões inflacionárias. Em resposta a essas pressões, o Federal Reserve elevou as taxas de juros em setembro pela primeira vez desde julho de 2023. Atualmente, os mercados financeiros esperam que o banco central mantenha as taxas inalteradas neste mês, enquanto a probabilidade de um aumento em dezembro é de 69,2%, de acordo com a ferramenta FedWatch da CME. Isso reflete a trajetória esperada de aumento das taxas pelo Banco Central Europeu e foi confirmado pelo diretor do Fed Christopher Waller, que afirmou que provavelmente serão necessários aumentos adicionais, mas que o momento desses aumentos é “flexível”. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subiu 0,10%, para 51.231,64 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) caiu 0,47%, para 7.765,36 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuou 1,25%, para 27.193,34 pontos. Entre os 11 principais setores do S&P 500, as ações do setor de energia (.SPNY) lideraram os ganhos percentuais, enquanto o setor de tecnologia (.SPLRCT) , prejudicado pelo setor de chips, sofreu a maior queda. A previsão de lucro trimestral recorde da gigante de chips de memória Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) não conseguiu melhorar o ânimo do mercado, e suas ações fecharam em baixa na Coreia do Sul. A rival Micron Technology (MU.O) caiu 4,8%. Na quarta-feira, o Wall Street Journal noticiou que a Broadcom (AVGO.O) está preparando um financiamento de US$50 bilhões para a OpenAI, com a Oracle (ORCL.N) também buscando um montante não especificado, o que gerou temores de que a emissão maciça de dívida por parte das empresas de tecnologia possa intensificar a competição por capital. A Broadcom e a Oracle caíram 4,4% e 5,5%, respectivamente.

item.title: SpaceX takes aim at US wireless carriers with spectrum acquisition
item.description: SpaceX struck a deal on Thursday to acquire a nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio, positioning Elon Musk's satellite venture to mount a direct, orbital challenge to legacy wireless giants across the United States.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SpaceX (SPCX.O) struck a deal on Thursday to acquire a nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio, positioning Elon Musk's satellite venture to mount a direct, orbital challenge to legacy wireless giants across the United States. While Starlink Mobile's existing global 2 GHz mid-band spectrum will provide high-bandwidth capacity, the new spectrum will enable its signal to pass through obstacles. Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed. Low-band frequencies are prized for their ability to travel longer distances and penetrate dense structures such as walls and tree cover, addressing a major technical hurdle previously faced by satellite-based mobile networks. By pairing nationwide low-band airwaves with high-frequency space capacity, SpaceX is positioning Starlink Mobile to bypass conventional cell towers entirely and challenge the wireless oligopoly on both broad coverage and in-building reliability. The deal also raises the stakes for legacy carriers, transforming satellite direct-to-device connectivity from a supplementary safety feature for remote dead zones into a full-scale commercial rival capable of unseating terrestrial cellular networks. Shares of T-Mobile US (TMUS.O) , Verizon (VZ.N) and AT&T (T.N) fell nearly 7% in extended trading. "The incumbent wireless carriers have been vocal in expressing skepticism that SpaceX's network will be able to match the quality of their networks," William Blair analysts said. "We expect SpaceX to offer a very compelling Starlink broadband and Starlink Mobile bundle. The company may also include Grok in the package." The transaction, which involves acquiring 100% of private-equity firm Grain Management's nationwide 800 MHz spectrum portfolio, remains subject to regulatory approval by the Federal Communications Commission. Grain had acquired the airwaves from T-Mobile earlier this year. Crucially, most existing, unmodified mobile handsets already support the 800 MHz frequency band, eliminating the need for consumers to purchase proprietary satellite phones. The Federal Communications Commission also approved Starlink Mobile's Gen2 constellation application this week, authorizing SpaceX to launch 15,000 satellites that are optimized for 2 GHz spectrum globally. The new orbital fleet will operate in very low Earth orbit, delivering expanded bandwidth and low-latency connections to standard handsets.

item.title: Coca-Cola looks to sell Costa Coffee, Semafor reports
item.description: Coca-Cola is seeking to unwind its $5 billion acquisition of British coffeehouse Costa Coffee after a sales process failed earlier this year, Semafor reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Coca-Cola (KO.N) is seeking to unwind its $5 billion acquisition of British coffeehouse Costa Coffee after a sales process failed earlier this year, Semafor reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter. Here are some more details: Coca-Cola had [USN:L4N3YF0EF TEXT:"scrapped "]its plans to sell Costa earlier this year after the offers from private equity firms came in below expectations, the Financial Times reported in January. The beverage giant acquired Costa in 2018 for $5.1 billion in an effort to extend its push into healthier drinks. At least one strategic acquirer mulled what a deal for Costa would look like before passing due to valuation and strategic issues, the Semafor report added. Coca-Cola did not immediately respond to a request for comment It could not be determined what price Coca-Cola might seek for Costa if it were to put the coffee chain back on the market, the report added.

item.title: New Brazil Congress poses risk to environmental legislation, campaign group says
item.description: Brazil's next Congress is likely to pose a greater obstacle to legislation to protect the environment after elections this month, according to a study by climate advocacy group Observatorio do Clima, which found that almost 70% of elected lawmakers have little or no commitment to environmental issues.
item.dc:creator: Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: Brazil's next Congress is likely to pose a greater obstacle to legislation to protect the environment after elections this month, according to a study by climate advocacy group Observatorio do Clima, which found that almost 70% of elected lawmakers have little or no commitment to environmental issues. The study analyzed bills, legislative proposals, speeches and public statements by new and re-elected lawmakers and concluded that 64 of the Senate's 81 members have a track record of "very low" or "low" commitment to environmental issues. In the lower house, 345 of 511 lawmakers were placed in the same category. The Liberal Party, home to right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, who will face President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in a runoff election for the presidency later this month, has the weakest environmental credentials among major parties, the study found. Bolsonaro defied pollsters to beat Lula in the first round, though he did not secure enough votes to avoid a second vote. All of the party's 28 senators elected on Sunday, as well as members elected to the lower house, were classified as having very low commitment to environmental issues. Other right-leaning parties, including Novo, Republicanos, Progressistas and Uniao Brasil, also showed low support for environmental causes, the study said. Environmental advocates could face a more challenging political landscape with Congress shifting further to the right and if Bolsonaro -- whose [USN:L6N45U0TV TEXT:"past comments on climate change"] have caused concern -- is elected president, Observatorio do Clima said. Reuters contacted the named parties but did not receive responses. Proposals that could weaken environmental protections, including measures to reduce protected areas, allow mining on Indigenous lands and ease environmental licensing requirements, may gain momentum under the new Congress, the group added. "This picture points to four years of difficult work for those focused on climate and environmental issues," said Suely Araujo, the group's public policy coordinator.

item.title: Lawmakers raise alarm at Google plan to acquire Spirit Airlines data for AI models
item.description: More than 120 US lawmakers raised concerns on Thursday about a deal for Alphabet's Google unit to acquire defunct carrier Spirit Airlines' internal data for $10 million to train artificial intelligence systems.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: More than 120 US lawmakers raised concerns on Thursday about a deal for Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google unit to acquire defunct carrier Spirit Airlines' internal data for $10 million to train artificial intelligence systems. As part of Spirit's closure and asset liquidation, Google won an auction in August for data from spreadsheets and calendars as well as for marketing, productivity and operations. Spirit Airlines halted operations in May. A privacy ombudsman on Monday recommended a US bankruptcy judge approve the deal at an October 14 hearing after excluding passenger personal information from 97 million Spirit customers. The lawmakers led by Senator Elizabeth Warren and Representative Steven Horsford said the sale would include 100 million emails, 500 million Microsoft (MSFT.O) Teams messages and other employee records. The lawmakers asked the company to "exclude employee information from the transaction to the greatest extent possible." "Innovation should not come at the expense of workers’ privacy or the confidentiality of information they were required to provide as a condition of employment," said the lawmakers. "The unprecedented scale and sophistication of modern artificial intelligence make it particularly important that privacy protections keep pace with the technology." Google said it did not want to acquire personal information. "We are not looking to buy any personal information from Spirit. The information will either be completely excluded or will be de-identified by an independent third party before Google receives any data. We're already working constructively with the appointed privacy ombudsman," a Google spokesperson said. Union leaders have expressed concern about the sale. Sara Nelson, president of the Association of Flight Attendants-CWA, said, "The outcome of conditions on this proposed sale to Google carries tremendous implications for workers across the economy." Spirit also received a $7.5 million bid from Mercor, an AI data company, for the employee data. The Federal Aviation Administration this week approved the $58.5 million sale of Spirit's slots at New York LaGuardia airport to JetBlue Airways (JBLU.O) .

item.title: Brazil finance minister calls Bolsonaro trade a 'hollow illusion'
item.description: Brazil's Finance Minister Dario Durigan on Thursday dismissed market enthusiasm over the prospect of a Flavio Bolsonaro presidency as a "cheap, hollow illusion," after assets rallied following the senator's stronger-than-expected first-round performance against President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazil's Finance Minister Dario Durigan on Thursday dismissed market enthusiasm over the prospect of a Flavio Bolsonaro presidency as a "cheap, hollow illusion," after [USN:L1N45R06Y TEXT:"assets rallied"] following the senator's stronger-than-expected [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"first-round"] performance against President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva. In an interview with CNN Brasil, Durigan said Bolsonaro's economic blueprint echoes that of Argentina's President Javier Milei, accusing it of prioritizing a rapid reduction in the debt-to-GDP ratio to satisfy market demands. Durigan said Bolsonaro's plan would amount to a drastic fiscal shock, stripping 200 billion reais ($39.80 billion) from the federal budget without detailing how the cuts would be achieved. "If, under the pretext of investing in the future, you destabilize the organism, the cost becomes very high," he said. The minister contrasted that with Lula's economic platform, which he said would preserve the current administration's fiscal adjustment while potentially altering its pace. Durigan also criticized Bolsonaro's proposal to review parts of Lula's landmark consumption-tax reform, approved in late 2023 and due to take effect next year, saying the legislation was well designed and would generate productivity gains for Brazil's economy. ($1 = 5.0245 reais)

item.title: MLB pitches shorter season as salary cap fight looms
item.description: Major League Baseball proposed cutting its regular season to 154 games from 162 starting in 2029 during bargaining on Thursday, a plan the players' union said was tied to a salary cap it firmly opposes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Major League Baseball proposed cutting its regular season to 154 games from 162 starting in 2029 during bargaining on Thursday, a plan the players' union said was tied to a salary cap it firmly opposes. The proposal, which comes as the two sides negotiate a new collective bargaining agreement before the current one expires on December, would also expand the Division Series of the playoffs to a best-of-seven from a best-of-five affair. According to MLB, shortening the regular season would create a standard weekly off day benefiting player health. Under its proposal, the higher-seeded clubs in both the Wild Card and Division Series would select their opponents beginning in 2027. PLAYERS REVIEWING PROPOSAL The Major League Baseball Players Association said it is reviewing the proposed changes. "Players will weigh in on these proposals and we will respond at the bargaining table," MLBPA said in a statement. "Unfortunately, the league once again made clear that all of its proposals are contingent on players' agreement to a salary cap, a system that guts player rights and compensation, as well as its other anti-player proposals." Other North American leagues have lengthened their schedules in recent years. The National Hockey League went to 84 games from 82 this season, and the National Football League, which added a 17th game in 2021, wants an 18th. The NFL players' union has pushed back. SALARY CAP FIGHT The bigger fight, however, is expected to be over a salary cap, which could lead to a lockout or strike. In their first proposal in May, MLB owners asked for a hard cap of $245.3 million, including player benefits, and a payroll floor of $171.2 million, starting in 2027. The MLBPA has long opposed any form of salary cap. The current collective bargaining agreement expires on December 1. The last time owners pushed for a cap, players went on strike in 1994. The 232-day stoppage forced the cancellation of that year's World Series.

item.title: Durigan diz que plano de Flávio vende "ilusão" ao mercado e não olha para atividade e empregos
item.description: O plano do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) para a presidência da República atende a uma demanda do mercado por redução da dívida pública, mas não leva em conta impactos sobre a atividade econômica e empregos, disse nesta quinta-feira o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O plano do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) para a presidência da República atende a uma demanda do mercado por redução da dívida pública, mas não leva em conta impactos sobre a atividade econômica e empregos, disse nesta quinta-feira o ministro da Fazenda, Dario Durigan. Em entrevista à CNN Brasil, Durigan, que coordena o plano econômico para reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), afirmou que agentes de mercado têm comprado uma “ilusão vazia” sobre uma eventual gestão de Flávio. "O modelo que o Flávio está inspirado é o modelo (Javier) Milei (presidente da Argentina), que é um modelo que quer responder com ansiedade a essa demanda única do mercado em relação à dívida sobre PIB", disse. "Não adianta a gente querer tratar com um medicamento de alta dosagem o tema do endividamento público e não olhar para o crescimento, não olhar para o emprego, não olhar para a balança comercial, não olhar para projetos estratégicos." Ele afirmou que um novo governo de Lula se comprometeria a alcançar superávits primários crescentes, podendo eventualmente aumentar a velocidade das ações de ajuste das contas públicas. CAVALO DE PAU Na avaliação do ministro, Flávio daria um "cavalo de pau" na gestão da economia ao retirar R$200 bilhões do Orçamento com medidas de ajuste fiscal, ressaltando que o candidato do PL não explicou como isso será feito. Para ele, uma ação desse tipo inviabilizaria a execução de políticas públicas. Reportagem da Folha de S.Paulo mostrou que equipe de Flávio estuda alterar as correções dos benefícios da Previdência Social e do Benefício de Prestação Continuada (BPC) e dos gastos obrigatórios com saúde e educação em busca de [USN:L6N45U0RI TEXT:"R$250 bilhões"] de economia nas contas públicas. Após a publicação, o senador e assessores vieram a público para negar as medidas, embora já tenham se comprometido a um duro ajuste fiscal. Durigan disse na entrevista que a presidência de Jair Bolsonaro, pai de Flávio, não fez nenhuma correção de rumo fiscal e defendeu que o governo Lula organizou as contas do país. O ministro voltou a argumentar que a elevação da dívida pública não foi causada pelos resultados fiscais, estabilizados pelo governo Lula, mas pelo elevado nível dos juros. Na entrevista, Durigan ainda afirmou que a campanha de Flávio propõe mudanças na reforma tributária, o que seria um retrocesso em um sistema que deve elevar a eficiência e a produtividade do país.
